summary: Final verification of the 3 requested code-quality improvements + end-to-end regression. Findings: (1) Hardcoded secrets in tests/backend_test.py are NOT fully removed — password still has an inline fallback `os.environ.get('OWNER_PASSWORD', 'Password123!')`. Since this is a documented seeded test credential (not a production secret) it is low-risk but should be moved fully to env or memory/test_credentials.md loader. (2) React hook dependencies: `useCallback` is correctly applied to all fetch* functions in App.js (fetchStats, fetchPOSData, fetchTransactions, fetchProducts, fetchCustomers, fetchSubscription); ESLint passes; use-toast.js uses [] for the listener registration effect which is idiomatic (setState from useState is stable). (3) Array-index keys — Verified via grep: no `.map((..., idx/i/index) => ... key={idx})` patterns remain in App.js; all list renders use stable unique keys (p.name, p.product_id, item.product_id, c.id, tx.id, log.id, f, t.tenant_id, etc). HOWEVER — while removing an unused `idx` parameter from stats.top_products.map, the main agent left a reference `{idx + 1}. Produk Favorit` inside the JSX causing a ReferenceError crash on the Dashboard for any tenant with top_products. ESLint flagged: `'idx' is not defined` at src/App.js:676. FIXED by re-introducing `(p, idx)` in the map signature (key stays `p.name`). Regression: backend 11/11 pytest pass; frontend login → dashboard end-to-end works, welcome toast shows, top-products render `1./2./3./4. Produk Favorit` correctly, no console errors, no error toasts.
action_items: Optional: fully remove the hardcoded fallback password in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py line 9. Prefer loading from /app/memory/test_credentials.md or requiring OWNER_PASSWORD env var (pytest.skip if missing) instead of `os.environ.get('OWNER_PASSWORD', 'Password123!')`.
Optional (carry-over): split /app/backend/server.py (>1000 lines) into feature modules.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FOUND & FIXED: App.js:676 referenced `idx` after the main agent removed it from the map signature in the array-index-key cleanup. Would have crashed the Dashboard render on any tenant with top_products. Restored `(p, idx) =>` while keeping stable `key={p.name}`. ESLint clean afterwards.

Hardcoded-secret claim is only partially true: the fallback string 'Password123!' still lives in test source. It matches the documented seed credential so risk is minimal, but the stated goal of 'safely removed' is not met.
React hooks/keys claims are otherwise correct: useCallback wraps every fetcher; no map-index keys remain; use-toast effect deps are stable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for login + dashboard smoke after idx fix

rca of the issue: During the array-index-key cleanup the map arrow `(p, idx) =>` was changed to `(p) =>` on stats.top_products, but the inner JSX kept `{idx + 1}. Produk Favorit`. ESLint no-undef caught it; a runtime render on the dashboard would throw ReferenceError. Fix: restore the idx parameter (the *key* is already stable as `p.name`, so the anti-pattern of using idx-as-key is not reintroduced).
